notes: Base styled glyph of the source notation \(\mathfrak X_X\); Ehrenfeucht--Mostowski 1956 p.54.

role: first-order logic over a vocabulary
notes: \(\mathbb L(\tau)\) in Shelah 2004 Definition 0.2; the vocabulary is \(\tau\).

role: class of relational systems used to relativize subsystems and homogeneity
notes: Morley--Vaught 1962 pp.39 and43; the local application takes all systems of the required similarity type.

role: structure and its relational graph expansion
notes: The primes denote the graph expansion in the theory-form proof.

role: relational model supplied by the two-cardinal theorem
notes: The graph predicates recover its original function and constant interpretations.

role: relational system in the Morley--Vaught construction
notes: The source distinguishes its universe from its power; decorations denote the explicitly defined expansions and reducts.

role: relational system in the Morley--Vaught construction
notes: It may be a subsystem or a comparison system as specified at the occurrence.

role: class operation taking all isomorphic copies of systems
notes: Morley--Vaught 1962 p.39; the argument is a class of relational systems.

role: subsystem class operation in the Morley--Vaught notation
notes: \(\mathscr S(\mathfrak A)\) is the class of all subsystems; cardinal subscripts restrict their power.

role: relational system with distinguished elements in the joint-consistency argument
notes: Primes name the similar comparison system and the common extension.

role: auxiliary relational model or indexed relativized reduct
notes: The unindexed model is obtained by compactness; the indexed reducts are defined separately in the proof of display (7).

role: relational system in the homogeneous-model recursion
notes: Primes and ordinal subscripts identify elementary extensions and chain stages.

role: common reduct system supplied by joint consistency
notes: Used with named elements and added relations in the one-point extension step.

role: first-order logic over L extended by the unary quantifier Q
notes: Base styled glyph in \(\mathscr L(Q)\); its satisfaction uses the specified family of subsets.

role: underlying first-order structure of a self-extending quantifier model
notes: The pair \((\mathfrak A,q)\) adds a family of subsets of its domain.

notes: It interprets the predicates \(P_{Qx\phi}\) and satisfies extensionality; this is not a saturated ambient model.

role: canonical extension built from definable functions modulo the quantifier family
notes: Its elements are equivalence classes of definable functions.

role: term-generated substructure used in the hull construction
notes: Its universe is the set of term values at the selected element.

role: recursively expanded natural-number structure
notes: Its vocabulary includes the successive least-witness functions.

role: nonprincipal ultrafilter on the natural numbers
notes: The quantifier in the natural-number example is evaluated through this ultrafilter.

role: Boolean algebra of definable subsets of the model domain
notes: The definable members of the quantifier family form an ultrafilter on this algebra.

role: elementary extension amalgamating the ambient and comparison models
notes: The embedding fixes the original parameter model pointwise.

role: fixed saturated ambient model for forking arguments
notes: The saturation bound is chosen above the cardinals used in the application.

role: family of subsets in the Erdos--Makkai cutting argument
notes: The family and its complement family are tested for strong cuts.

role: subfamily of a restricted set family in the Erdos--Makkai argument
notes: It indexes the complemented traces in the second case of the proof.

role: diagram of a system: open sentences of L(A) true in A

role: directed family of parameter systems
notes: Any two systems embed by their inclusions into a third member, so their relations agree on overlaps.

role: fixed saturated ambient model for forking arguments
notes: The ambient convention also imposes the larger bound required by the simplicity arguments.

role: family of subsets of a finite set in the shattering count
notes: The proof compares its size with the number of subsets it shatters.

role: class of types with splitting trees of every finite height
notes: The transfinite argument shows that these types lie in every local rank stage.

role: auxiliary polynomial list in the uniform sign-table construction
notes: The list consists of lower-degree polynomials, coefficients and pseudo-remainders.

role: class of formulas equivalent to quantifier-free formulas over real closed fields
notes: It is closed under Boolean operations and the constructed existential elimination step.

role: union of two families of shattered subsets
notes: Local to the Sauer--Shelah induction; the two families come from the deleted-coordinate slices.

role: intersection of two families of shattered subsets
notes: Local to the Sauer--Shelah induction; its members yield shattered sets containing the distinguished point.
